description: Turn an established repeatable process into a usable controlled SOP.

provenance.author: LiNKskills Library
provenance.source: Pinned upstream modules copied with licenses and exact commit identities; see references/upstream/SOURCE-MANIFEST.json
provenance.license: See per-source upstream license copies and manifest

routing.when_to_use: Turn an established repeatable process into a usable controlled SOP.
when_not_to_use: A different task requires its own skill
exclusion_rules: Missing facts block the affected conclusion, not harmless drafting
ambiguity_rules: Read existing authorized evidence first; ask only material unanswered questions

required_inputs.name: task_inputs
required_inputs.description: observed process and responsible roles; trigger, prerequisites and intended reader; approval/exception rules; acceptance evidence

expected_outputs.name: work_product
expected_outputs.description: controlled SOP draft; execution checklist; walkthrough and revision record

forbidden_actions: Unapproved payments, filings, postings, signatures, purchases, external announcements or production changes
Inventing source facts, approval or canon
verification_steps: Use the supplied approved library template, heading/version/naming conventions; record purpose, process owner, audience, trigger, prerequisites and observed evidence. If none is supplied, label the proposed format as a draft.

Extract the actual process from records or walkthroughs. For every usually, unless, it depends or ask someone branch, ask a targeted gap question about criteria, owner and escalation; mark unresolved actions [TO CONFIRM] rather than invent an answer.

Write one concrete action per numbered step with actor, input, actual interface, output and check. Specify decision thresholds, exception handoffs, approvals, stop conditions and recovery; keep current practice separate from proposed improvements.

Include required forms, screenshots/placeholders, RACI, records, metrics and authorized retention/access references. Put fragility and suggested improvements in a separate risk note, not silently into the as-is SOP.

Pressure-test the draft as a new operator with no prior context using one normal case and one ambiguous exception. Identify each point requiring unstated judgment; repair or mark [TO CONFIRM], retain evidence and obtain the designated controlled-version approval.
completion_criteria: Task output meets contract and task-specific acceptance criteria
Sources, uncertainty, exact completion scope and remaining decisions visible
Any authorized draft write read back
known_limitations: Structural qualification does not prove every behavior
Source originals are provenance; canonical method owns execution
Specialist content/draft access may be Sara-mediated

telemetry.retention_policy: retain opaque task/source ids and hashes only
